removeLinkTitle: Remove from this responsibility. It stays wherever else it is filed.
proposedDescription: Confirm it to start giving its work to agents, or adjust the bar and numbers first.
letGoNotice: You let go of this. Take it back on from the menu to own it again.

projectsQuestion: What groups of work move the number?
